Class AccountService

java.lang.Object
AccountService
public class AccountService extends Object
Service class responsible for handling operations related to user accounts, such as account creation, deletion, and searching.

  • Method Details

    • createAccount

      public void createAccount()
      Creates a new account by prompting the user for necessary details such as login, pin, name, starting balance, and status. Ensures valid pin input and positive balance. Inserts the account data into the database.

    • deleteAccount

      public void deleteAccount()
      Deletes an existing account after verifying the account number provided by the user. Prompts for the account number, verifies its existence in the database, and asks for confirmation before deleting the account from the database.

    • updateAccount

      public void updateAccount()
      Updates an existing account's details such as name, status, login, and pin. Prompts the user for the account number, retrieves the account information from the database, and allows the user to update the account details. The account is updated in the database.

    • searchAccount

      public void searchAccount()
      Searches for an account by its account number. Prompts the user for the account number, retrieves the account information from the database, and displays the details if the account is found.

    • findAccount

      public Account findAccount(String login, String pin)
      Searches for an account by login and pin. Retrieves the account information from the database based on the provided login and pin. If the account is found, an Account object is created and returned.
      Parameters:
      login - the login of the account
      pin - the pin associated with the account
      Returns:
      the corresponding Account object, or null if no account is found.
